name: Sephirotic Scion Core: The Higher Register

description.value:
Ancestry Core (v1.1, RFI-native). Shared across all Sephirotic Scion heritages. Granted at character creation via the base ancestry item's ItemGrant advancement.

“Your blood remembers the higher spheres. Prayers sometimes answer themselves. The moral architecture feels like the weather report.”

Sephirotic Scion Core Traits

  • Sephirotic Physiology. You resist sephirotic damage. Your blood runs a little bright under the right light. You do not technically age on consecrated ground.
  • Sefirot Attunement. Pick one sephirah at creation. 1/scene, invoke its register for +1 rank bonus on a check clearly in its domain.
  • Holy Conduit. Sephirotic-register effects passing through you treat effective caster-attribute as +1. Applies to you and to allies; not to qliphothic-register effects.
  • Light of Harmony. When two or more creatures within 30 ft are in active explicit agreement, each gains 1 temporary Integrity. Refreshes on each new agreement reached.
⟁ Per-Use Ability — Sefirot Attunement
Recovery: 1/scene  ·  Action: Free (declare before roll)  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke.
Invoke your chosen sephirah for +1 rank bonus on a check clearly in its domain.
